summary.intent: Plan, execute, and ship Phase 62 'Unified Node Codec (Core Keystone)' of the CipherBox project using the GSD workflow system, introducing a unified `Node` discriminated union with dual-sealed bodies and generation-as-AAD, retiring legacy `folder/`+`file/` metadata types across the monorepo.
summary.outcome: Phase 62 was fully planned (9 plans/7 waves, plan-checker PASSED after 1 revision round), executed (190/190 core tests green, all consumers stubbed-to-compile per D-01, monorepo typechecks clean), and was mid-ship when the transcript ends — verification/security/Nyquist/simplify complete, sdk-e2e gap patched, CodeRabbit triaged with one in-scope hardening fix applied to `seal.ts`. PR not yet created.

repo: The GSD execute-phase subagents quarantine sdk unit suites per D-02 but systematically miss `tests/sdk-e2e/`, which is a separate CI job that triggers on any src change — sdk-e2e quarantine must be checked/applied manually in every compile-only phase.

sdk-e2e CI job is gated by `if: needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'` in ci.yml — any source change triggers it, so suites that import retired types will fail to even load unless quarantined with `describe.skip`.
`commit.gpgsign: false` is set in this environment — all GSD executor commits throughout the session are unsigned; this must be flagged before merge.
The PATTERNS.md file from the pattern-mapper hook is not committed by step 13d (known gap in GSD) — it requires an explicit `git add`+commit after the pattern-mapper subagent completes.

Root `pnpm typecheck`'s `tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json` step fails locally with TS2688 'node' because root `node_modules/@types/node` isn't linked, but `@types/node ^22` is declared in package.json so CI's fresh install resolves it — pre-existing environmental flake, not a code regression.

`landing/.astro/` is gitignored (0 tracked files, absent on origin/main) but generates local eslint errors that pollute scoped lint runs — always scope eslint to phase-modified paths, not the repo root.
`gh pr edit` fails on this repo (Projects-classic GraphQL) — PR body must be patched via `env -u GITHUB_TOKEN gh api -X PATCH repos/FSM1/cipher-box/pulls/<N> -F body=@file`.
The gsd commit helper (`query commit`) reliably reports `commit_failed`/`committed: false` while the commit actually lands — always verify with `git log --oneline -1`, never retry blindly.

The app is intentionally non-runnable mid-milestone (D-01): `client.ts` is gutted to throwing stubs; all real behavior is deferred to phases 63–69. The D-02 gate (monorepo typecheck + lint + core codec tests) is the actual ship gate for compile-only phases.
All 42 phase-62 commits used conventional scoped format (e.g., `feat(62):`, `test(62-03):`) from the start — the step-7 reword filter-branch is N/A for this phase.

CodeRabbit CLI (`--agent --base main --type committed`) on a 136-file diff produces ~59 suggestions but many target code that was already hardened by the executors — each suggestion must be verified against current code before applying.

code.finding: `unsealNode` was missing an envelope schema/aeadVersion guard — `published.schema` and `aeadVersion` fields are plaintext (not AAD-bound), so a v1 reader would silently accept future-versioned envelopes. Added a fail-closed forward-compat guard as an in-scope CodeRabbit finding.

Key-length asserts on `sealNode`/`unsealNode` are redundant — the underlying crypto primitives (`encrypt.ts`/`decrypt.ts`/`encrypt-ctr.ts`) already throw on `key.length !== AES_KEY_SIZE`. CodeRabbit suggested them; correctly skipped.
CodeRabbit's suggested base64-length guard in `decodeNode` was already implemented by the executor — no-op finding.
CodeRabbit's suggested `writeLen` bounds check in vault v3 deserialization was already implemented by the executor — no-op finding.

A base64 encode/decode helper is duplicated across `node/seal.ts`, `node/encode.ts`, and `node/decode.ts` — DRY nit, deferred as a todo (refactoring frozen codec files pre-ship is risky per D-04 freeze-first discipline).

All 11 sdk-e2e suites import `FilePointer` (retired type) and exercise the now-stubbed client; they were not quarantined by execute-phase executors. Added `describe.skip` with D-01 marker to all 11 suites to prevent CI gate failure.

workflow: Sequential execution (not worktrees) is the right default for pnpm monorepos with cross-package dist chains (core→sdk-core→sdk→web) — worktrees lack node_modules and the dist-chain serialization is simpler on one tree.
Freeze-first discipline (D-04): freeze golden vectors in `tests/vectors/` before any consumer seals — must be wave 2, before the cutover wave.
Nyquist validation requires `## Validation Architecture` in RESEARCH.md to produce VALIDATION.md; without research, plans lack Dimension-8 validation requirements.
When plan-checker flags `(RESOLVED)` markers missing in RESEARCH.md open-questions section, it is a blocker — resolution evidence must be inline in the research doc, not just implicit from the plan.

The plan-checker's Plan-08 size warning (>threshold files) is correctness-consequential for autonomous execution — large plans risk context exhaustion in executor subagents; splitting into 08a/08b (logic vs component layer) de-risks it.
When running parallel CodeRabbit CLI on large diffs, arm a bounded waiter (not indefinite poll) — the `--agent` summarization step can take 5–10+ minutes on 136-file diffs.
After any `github-actions[bot]` `chore(release)` push, `git fetch` + rebase is mandatory before the next push — the remote will reject without it.

friction: gsd commit helper false-negative: `query commit` consistently reports `commit_failed`/`committed: false` even when commits land cleanly — requires manual `git log` verification after every commit.
Inline `node -e` with multi-line JSON arguments from `--pick` shell expansions caused word-splitting/quoting failures — had to write JSON to a temp file and parse from disk.
Requirements-coverage loop display bug: all 6 NODE requirement IDs printed as a single token on first run, showing '✗ UNCOVERED' for all — had to re-run cleanly to get accurate output.
Web tsc false error: `pnpm --filter @cipherbox/web exec tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.build.json` throws TS5058 (web has no `tsconfig.build.json`); correct invocation is `tsc -b`.

GPG signing: `commit.gpgsign: false` is set in environment — all 42 commits are unsigned, which must be flagged at merge time; the 2-minute 'hang' on the sdk-e2e quarantine commit was lint-staged (slow `check-api-client.sh`) not a signer wedge.

Local TS2688 'node' from `tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json`: stale local `node_modules/@types/node` causes this to fail locally but pass on CI — a known environmental flake that took investigation to confirm as pre-existing.
CodeRabbit CLI took longer than expected (8+ minute bounded wait) to summarize the 136-file diff in `--agent` mode.

sdk-e2e quarantine gap: the execute-phase orchestrator and executor agents consistently skip `tests/sdk-e2e` when applying D-02 quarantine — this is a systematic gap in the GSD execute-phase workflow that required manual repair at ship time.
